text:
nina: FYI 15min sync: competitor pushed tenant routing + simple SLO toggles. Sales pinged. Need quick take: ship parity fast or push our richer policy UX?
raj: How many active deals asking specifically for routing?
ellen: Two enterprise pilots and one inbound RFP. All cite predictable routing as a must-have. Not immediate churn but blocks signatures.
sam: Their controls are shallow. We still have opportunity to sell advanced policy logic, but loss risk on short deals.
maria: Legal asked if parity requires new compliance docs. Might be fine for API-only.
own: Engineering estimate: API-only tenant routing + basic SLO tags = 3 weeks if we scope tightly. Full policy editor = 10-12 weeks.
nina: Proposed paths: 1) Rapid parity (API & docs) in 3wks; 2) Hold for full editor; 3) Two-step: quick API now, editor later. Thoughts?
raj: Two-step looks safest. We must ensure we don't ship a confusing half-baked offering. Need clear boundaries in docs and sales script.
sam: Agree. Also create a short "what this does/doesn't" one-pager for sales and support.
own: Rollout plan: feature-flag, canary with 2 pilot tenants, perf guardrails (p99 latency, error rate), and telemetry hooks. Can do canary in week 4 after tests.
maria: I'll prep the compliance checklist for API-only. No new data exposure expected but add KMS note.
ellen: Sales: we'll ask pilots to sign a short pilot addendum. Need a demo flow and rollback language.
nina: Launch criteria draft: a) End-to-end smoke + regression tests green, b) Canary w/ 2 pilots for 5 business days with no critical errors, c) Dashboard showing per-tenant latency/cost, d) Sales one-pager + support runbook.
raj: I'll own the API surface and perf tests. Sam can do the one-pager. Owen will lead rollout infra. Maria approves compliance checklists.
sam: I'll mock a CLI snippet and a minimal curl example for docs.
product-bot: note created: epic #EPC-1229 "routing parity fastpath"

nina: Decision: two-step approach. Start 3-week scoped API sprint, then policy editor Q-target. Quick stand in 30m to triage requirements. :shipit:
